bridges.title_part1: From your community to a network
bridges.intro: The pilot cohort stems from active cooperation between Campina Grande, Brazil, and Enghien-les-Bains, France, connecting global creative territories.
bridges.p1: International cooperation and the mobilization of the Brazilian Network of UNESCO Creative Cities (RBCC) expand possibilities for encounters between repertoires, challenges and solutions. Specific partner institutions and masters will be revealed upon confirmation.
bridges.disclaimer: References to the RBCC and Creative Cities describe collaborative networks; they do not imply direct UNESCO certification or institutional endorsement for the Residency.

items.q: Do I need to be a professional artist to participate?
items.a: No. The residency is designed for hybrid profiles: creators, designers, developers, researchers, and managers. The essential requirement is professional or academic maturity and genuine interest in creating and collaborating.

items.q: How does the International Travel Super Award work?
items.a: Four selected residents (two from Brazil and two from France) will receive round-trip airfare and accommodation for a 10-day immersion at the Centre des Arts in Enghien-les-Bains (Greater Paris) or Campina Grande, including ateliers, mentoring, and project showcases.

items.q: How does the Dual 7-Day & Transformation Guarantee work?
items.a: You have 7 days after starting to withdraw and receive 100% of your money back with no questions asked. Furthermore, if you actively participate throughout the residency and verify that it brought no tangible value, you may request a full refund review at the end of the programme.

items.q: What is the activity format (online or in-person)?
items.a: The programme is hybrid: weekly live online sessions, continuous follow-up in our virtual atelier, and hands-on immersion moments (such as the HackArtThon and the awardees’ exchange trip).

items.q: How do social scholarships / fellowships work?
items.a: The programme includes 10 full social places for Brazil and 10 social places for France. Socioeconomic and territorial representation criteria will be detailed when the social selection call opens.

privacy.modal_subtitle: International transparency applied to the bilateral cooperation Campina Grande (Brazil) ↔ Enghien-les-Bains (France / EU).
privacy.section_controller_title: 1. Joint Data Controller & Data Protection Officer (DPO)
privacy.section_controller_body: Your personal data is jointly managed by the ArtInnova International Residency coordination teams in Brazil and France (European Union). Official DPO contact channel: contact@artinnovaresidency.com.
privacy.section_legal_title: 2. Purpose & Lawful Bases (GDPR Art. 6 · LGPD Art. 7)
privacy.section_legal_body: We process your name, email, city/country, profile, and referral based on your explicit consent for institutional communications and selection outreach, as well as contract performance upon enrollment on the learning platform.
privacy.section_transfer_body: As an international bilateral residency, academic data may be accessed by curatorial and faculty teams in Brazil and France under TLS encryption, standard safeguards, and equivalent protection rules (GDPR Chapter V Arts. 44–49 · LGPD Art. 33).
privacy.section_rights_title: 4. Retention & Your Rights (CNIL France / EU · ANPD Brazil)
privacy.section_rights_body: Expression-of-interest records are retained for up to 24 months or until consent withdrawal. You have the right to access, rectify, port (JSON), restrict, object, or erase your data at any time via contact@artinnovaresidency.com or inside the learning platform under 'My Profile & Privacy'. Supervisory authorities: CNIL (France/EU) and ANPD (Brazil).
privacy.cookie_essential_desc: Always active to preserve language choice and protect forms against automated abuse.
